title: Be Careful....deceiving, but good little machine.
text:
Be Careful....deceiving, but good little machine.. B careful! Good little machine but deceiving. Don't get too close to the blades ( even if you only have 1/2 zuchini or squash completed). That's all, anything more will rip your fingers up. Just be careful. 2 of us used it and fingers shredded. BUT realized only A small portion of the veggie sufficed. You will be left with a half of Zuc/squash.
Nothing wrong with that. Once you get the hang of it.... great for the price.
